Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/run_eval.sh:
     1	#!/bin/bash
     2	# Sandbox-side bridge command -- same interface as the local run_eval.sh,
     3	# but talks to the deployed grader over HTTP (GRADER_URL) since sealed/
     4	# isn't present in this sandbox at all.
     5	set -euo pipefail
     6	cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"
     7	exec python run_eval.py "$@"
